card.name: Space or period before section numbers
card.fires_on: The space or period right before a section or chapter number, in cross-references like "Drug Interactions (7.1)" or citations like "chap 197". It fires where the next token is a number naming a section.

modes.label: Label cross-references
modes.description: The space or period inside a parenthetical section reference after a heading such as Drug Interactions.

modes.label: Citation chapters
modes.description: The space after chap or section in a textbook citation, before the number.
modes.example: Schafer AI, eds. Cecil Medicine. 24th ed. Philadelphia, PA: Saunders Elsevier; 2011:chap<< >>197. David C. D

modes.label: Decimal section numbers
modes.description: The period within a section number such as 13.3 or 7.1.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning section or chapter, such as "section", "chapter", "dedicated", and "devoted".
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a section or chapter number in a cross-reference or citation.
